hero.purpose: Homepage Oracle Tutor mark only. Two stacked uppercase words.

display.purpose: Pinned-card results title. Fixed at 2.4rem so the surface doesn't reflow on resize.

card-name.purpose: Detail overlay heading. Fluid clamp for one-shot magazine plate.

body.purpose: Oracle text and prose. Always monospace.

label.purpose: Section labels, button captions, metadata keys. Carried by .eyebrow class.

shadows.name: overlay-plate
shadows.purpose: Anchors the detail overlay panel against the dimmed scrim. The single large shadow in the system.

shadows.name: overlay-card
shadows.purpose: Smaller drop under the card image inside the detail overlay's image plate.

motion.name: duration-image-fade
motion.purpose: Card image opacity fade-in on load.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Result grid switches from 2 to 3 columns.

breakpoints.name: results-mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Results header collapses, summary bar shrinks.

breakpoints.name: overlay-mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Detail overlay switches from two-plate spread to single-column scrolling document.

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Default interactive button. Inverts to filled ink on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #111111; border: 2px solid #111111; border-radius: 0; padding: 12px 18px; font-family: 'Big Shoulders Display', sans-serif; font-weight: 900; font-size: 0.78rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.12em; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #111111; color: #f0ede6; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #cc1100; outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-btn-ghost { transition: none; } }

components.name: Close Button
components.description: Square 58px close glyph used in the detail overlay header. Hover fills with editor's red.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-close" aria-label="Close"><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="14" height="14" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 3l10 10M13 3L3 13"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-close { width: 58px; height: 58px; background: transparent; color: #111111; border: 0; border-left: 2px solid #111111; border-radius: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-btn-close:hover { background: #cc1100; color: #ffffff; } .ds-btn-close:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #cc1100; outline-offset: -2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-btn-close { transition: none; } }

components.name: Eyebrow Label
components.description: Universal section label. Uppercase monospace at 0.6875rem with wide tracking, in faded-mark gray.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { margin: 0; color: #7a7670; font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1.2; }

components.name: Result Card
components.description: Frameless card image with monospace similarity caption beneath. Both fade in together when the image finishes loading.
components.html: 87%
components.css: .ds-result-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-result-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-result-card__open { display: block; width: 100%; padding: 0; background: transparent; border: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-result-card__img { display: block; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 63 / 88; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 0.75rem; transition: opacity 500ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-result-card__cap { padding: 0 4px; font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.625rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #7a7670; transition: color 500ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-result-card:hover .ds-result-card__cap { color: #cc1100; } .ds-result-card__open:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #cc1100; outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-result-card, .ds-result-card__img, .ds-result-card__cap { transition: none; } }

components.name: Topbar Header
components.description: Sticky top bar from the results view. Brand mark, search inset, filter button, all separated by 2px ink rules.
components.css: .ds-topbar { display: grid; grid-template-columns: clamp(148px, 16vw, 176px) 1fr auto; min-height: 58px; border-bottom: 2px solid #111111; background: #f0ede6; } .ds-topbar__brand { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0 18px; background: transparent; color: #111111; border: 0; border-right: 2px solid #111111; font-family: 'Big Shoulders Display', sans-serif; font-weight: 900; font-size: 20px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: -0.02em; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-topbar__brand:hover { background: #111111; color: #f0ede6; } .ds-topbar__search { display: flex; align-items: stretch; background: #ffffff; } .ds-topbar__input { width: 100%; padding: 0 18px; background: transparent; border: 0; outline: 0; font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; color: #111111; } .ds-topbar__input::placeholder { color: #7a7670; } .ds-topbar__filter { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 16px; background: transparent; color: #111111; border: 0; border-left: 2px solid #111111; font-family: 'Big Shoulders Display', sans-serif; font-weight: 900; font-size: 0.6875rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.12em; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-topbar__filter:hover { background: #111111; color: #f0ede6; }

components.name: Detail Metadata Row
components.description: A row from the detail overlay metadata definition list. Eyebrow label left, display-type value right, 1px newsprint-rule divider beneath.
components.css: .ds-meta-row { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 10px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #d8d2c8; } .ds-meta-row:last-child { border-bottom: 0; } .ds-meta-row__key { margin: 0; color: #7a7670; font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-meta-row__val { margin: 0; text-align: right; color: #111111; font-family: 'Big Shoulders Display', sans-serif; font-weight: 900; font-size: 1.05rem; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.01em; text-transform: uppercase; }

narrative.overview: Oracle Tutor is laid out like a magazine spread, not an app shell. Every page is a composition: hard 2px ink rules section the canvas, big uppercase display type carries titles, monospace carries oracle text and labels. The dense oracle-text background lives behind the entire shell, drifting at 8.8% opacity like newsprint pulled close to the eye. The single accent, an editor's red stripe down the left edge of the viewport, is the brand mark that never moves. The personality is editorial, confident, and quietly playful. Restraint is the dominant gesture, but the system permits theatrics where they earn it: the homepage hero swells to 7rem, the detail overlay opens into a two-plate spread with the card framed against a hush of newsprint-rule gray, and the result grid drops every frame so the cards themselves are the content.
keyCharacteristics: 2px ink rules, never 1px hairlines or soft shadows
Display type for titles, monospace for body and labels, no third family
Restrained color: tinted neutrals + one accent, used at < 5% of any surface
Frameless card images at uniform rounded-xl (0.75rem) corners
A persistent dense-text background and a persistent left red stripe across all routes
No drop shadows except a single low-key shadow under the detail overlay panel

rules.name: The One Stripe Rule
rules.body: The 6px editors-red left stripe is sacred. It paints over every shell, never collides with content, and is the only place red appears at full bleed. Anywhere else, red is at most 1% of the visible surface.

rules.name: The Two-Color Floor
rules.body: A composition is finished when it reads in pressed-ink and newsprint-cream alone. Gray is for the second pass. Red is for the third pass at most. If the design only works with all three, it's overworked.

rules.name: The Display-Stays-Out-Of-Body Rule
rules.body: Big Shoulders Display never sets paragraphs. If the text is more than ~5 words, it's body, and body is monospace.

rules.name: The Uppercase-Is-Structural Rule
rules.body: Every uppercase string is structural (a title, a label, a button). Never decorative. Lowercase belongs to taglines and prose, exclusively.

rules.name: The No-Fluid-Title Rule
rules.body: The pinned-card results title is fixed at 2.4rem because the user lands on it repeatedly across a session and a fluid clamp made the surface feel unstable. Hero and card-name fluid clamps are tolerated only where the surface is one-shot.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Card frames are forbidden. Soft shadows are forbidden. The only allowed shadow is the detail-overlay pair, which exist because the overlay is the only surface that floats.

rules.name: The Rule-Over-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Where a SaaS dashboard would draw a 1px gray hairline and add a soft shadow to imply depth, this system draws a 2px pressed-ink rule and stops.

dos: Do use 2px pressed-ink (#111111) rules to section the canvas. Hard rules are the entire elevation language.
Do keep the 6px editors-red (#cc1100) left stripe unbroken across every route. It's the brand mark.
Do let the dense oracle-text background show through gaps in the layout. The result grid's gaps are intentionally background-transparent.
Do invert ghost buttons on hover to pressed-ink fill / newsprint-cream text. That single language carries every interactive element.
Do drop chrome that doesn't pull weight: card frames, card-count tags, redundant Results titles for free-text searches, set-symbol decorations.
Do use .eyebrow class for every secondary label (faded-mark, 0.6875rem, letter-spacing 0.18em, uppercase). Labels never freelance their own type.
Do gate every transition on motion-reduce:transition-none. Reduced motion is non-negotiable.
Do pin header bars at fixed min-height. Do not let header heights breathe with content.
donts: Don't ship Linear / Stripe / Notion product chrome: sidebars, soft drop shadows, blue accents, rounded-2xl cards, gradient buttons.
Don't ape Scryfall or EDHREC: dense data tables, set-symbol decorations, Wizards-of-the-Coast house typography.
Don't introduce neon glows, animated gradients, glassmorphism, or backdrop blurs as decoration.
Don't retreat to Inter + gray-on-white + rounded-2xl + evenly-spaced empty space.
Don't put display type on body copy. Big Shoulders Display never sets paragraphs.
Don't introduce a third type family. Two families, no exceptions.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored stripe on a card or list item.
Don't use #000 or #fff directly. pressed-ink (#111111) and newsprint-cream (#f0ede6) are the floors and the ceilings.
Don't add box-shadow to anything outside the detail overlay's two declared shadows.
Don't make titles or grid columns fluid where they're read repeatedly.
Don't open a modal as the first thought. The detail overlay exists because it's the right affordance.
